sub2: Here is what to do while it runs.

items.title: Don't panic-edit your site
items.why: Big rewrites mid-update make it hard to tell what actually moved your rankings.

items.title: Write down today's numbers
items.why: Note your traffic, calls and form leads now so you have a clean baseline.

items.title: Keep helping customers
items.why: Keep publishing useful pages and keep your Google Business Profile up to date.

items.title: Judge it a week after it ends
items.why: Google suggests waiting at least a week after the rollout finishes before comparing.

cta: Want a second set of eyes?
gbpTitle: Google core update: what to do
